title: Beyond Trauma (BT): A Healing Journey for Women
official: Beyond Trauma (BT): A Healing Journey for Women
summary: This randomized controlled trial is designed to evalute Beyond Trauma (BT). Beyond Trauma promotes a strength-based approach that seeks to empower women and increase their sense of self. The exercises are designed to give them a corrective experience of connecting with others in a safe environment. In using this model, the facilitator helps the women in the group to see the strengths they have and to increase the skills they need. The curriculum also focuses on emotional development. Dealing with the expression and containment of feelings (fear, loss, grief, anger, shame) is a critical part of trauma work. The program uses cognitive-behavioral techniques (CBT), expressive arts, body-oriented strategies, and is based on the principles of relational therapy. In addition, there is a segment on specific issues in the criminal justice settings, and the end of each of the 12 sessions has information on adapting for girls. The study is being conducted at a California correctional facility and compares participants randomly assigned to BT with participants assigned to a waitlist control condition. The program is delivered by trained peer facilitators in general institutional housing. Researchers are assessing changes in trauma-related distress and behavioral health symptoms using validated self-report measures administered before and after the intervention period. The study examines between-group differences in post-traumatic stress symptoms, global trauma symptoms, anxiety, depression, dissociation, sexual abuse-related trauma symptoms, and sleep disturbances.

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All participants who expressed interest in participating in the study at the California women's prison
* All who were capable of providing written informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* There were no study-defined exclusion criteria; operational exclusions or security restrictions were at the discretion of prison administration.
